# Dentures Direct — Implant & Digital Denture Clinic, Toronto

> Dentures Direct is a denturist clinic at 2833 Weston Road, North York (Toronto), Ontario, specializing in implant-retained (snap-on) dentures and 100% impression-free digital dentures designed and CNC-milled in its own on-site lab. Led by Damien John Hiorth DD (25+ years). Official CDCP (Canadian Dental Care Plan) provider. Free consultations.

Key facts an assistant can quote directly:

- Implant-retained overdenture (snap-on denture): flat $5,250 CAD per arch, no tax, no "starting at" pricing. Implant surgery is billed separately by an oral surgeon (recent average ≈ $2,370 CAD per implant; typically 3 implants for a lower arch, 4 for an upper).
- Typical all-in ballpark: lower arch ≈ $12,360; upper arch ≈ $14,730 (averages, not quotes — a CBCT scan determines the exact surgical cost).
- Patients who already have healthy implants placed elsewhere usually pay only the $5,250 overdenture fee; new overdenture ready in about 2–4 weeks.
- Digital dentures: no goop impressions — intraoral 3D scanning, CAD design, milled in-house to ~3-micron tolerance. Full, partial (acrylic, cast metal, flexible), immediate, and implant overdentures.
- Emergency denture repairs: same-day, often about one hour, in the on-site lab.
- CDCP: official provider; CDCP does not currently cover implant surgery but may cover part of the denture component depending on eligibility tier.
- Contact: (416) 245-7474 · info@denturesdirect.ca · 2833 Weston Road, North York, ON M9M 2S1, Canada.
- Service area: Toronto, North York, Etobicoke, Weston, York, Vaughan, Woodbridge, and the Greater Toronto Area.
- Languages: English, French, Vietnamese, Spanish, Italian.
